COMMON QUESTIONS

Planning a vertical line

When should I consider a vertical anodizing line?

It is a starting point for projects focused on long aluminium profiles and continuous, high-volume production. Profile range, available building height and the process route must be reviewed together.

Can the line be connected to a factory management system?

Daimeng describes network interfaces for production information exchange with MES and ERP systems. The data fields, protocols and integration responsibilities should be agreed for each project.

What do I need for an initial proposal?

Prepare your profile drawings, expected monthly output, required finishes, factory dimensions, available utilities and target commissioning date.
